say:4:1011124002:1.text: Lorsan, it's ridiculous! Years go by, not a peep from you. Not even a letter! Bryon sent you messages through the wind, and you just ignored us!
say:4:1011124002:1.source_cn: 真是的，你一走就是好几年，连封信也不给我写！托布莱恩他...

say:5:1011124003:0.text: He did respond with a single word: acknowledged.

say:7:1011124004:1.text: Well... Hmmm... I was in a hurry to bring us back a savior!

say:9:1011124006:1.text: Lorsan has been a bit of a troublemaker since he was young. I'm sorry if he caused any trouble for you along the way.
say:9:1011124006:1.source_cn: 洛桑从小就顽皮，一路上麻烦你们照顾了。

say:10:1011124007:1.text: Come on, Sister! It's been three years. Can't we catch up for a moment without digging into the past!

say:22:1011124017:0.text: The <style="highlight">Thorned Faction</style> has always leaned toward conservatism, not wanting outsiders to disturb the peace of the forest. A while back, the Thorned Guards proposed blocking the entrance to the forest.

say:30:1011124022:1.text: However, sir, despite the internal strife among the Wilders, it shouldn't be a reason for us to fail our refugee friends.
